AIRSTATION_HTTP_PORT.description: Airstation http port for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

AIRSTATION_DB_DIR.description: Airstation db dir for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

AIRSTATION_TRACKS_DIR.description: Airstation tracks dir for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

AIRSTATION_TMP_DIR.description: Airstation tmp dir for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

AIRSTATION_SECRET_KEY.description: Generated airstation secret key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

AIRSTATION_JWT_SIGN.description: Generated airstation jwt sign. Keep private and preserve with backups.

AIRSTATION_SECURE_COOKIE.description: Airstation secure cookie for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for airstation. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for airstation. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for airstation. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
